sources.excerpt: Regular price $199.99 By Stomp Under Foot Quantity Add to cart Released around 1993, the Civil War is the second evolution of the Russian muff, delivering the unmistakable tone heard in David Gilmour’s solo work. With its huge low-end, smooth fuzz, and dynamic response, this pedal produces soaring lead tones and full-bodied chords with just a hint of grit. Perfect for those chasing the iconic early ‘90s Russian fuzz sound. Whether you're after Gilmore-type sustain or a thick, vintage fuzz tone, this pedal delivers with warmth, articulation, and unmistakable character.
